description:
Beispiel: „Wie hat sich der Umsatz der Rauch Fruchtsäfte GmbH in den letzten fünf Jahren entwickelt?“

Per-year financial-metric history for ONE company, routed by its unified id.
        Read-only.

        Parameters:
        - company_id (required): "AT:{fnr}" or "DE:{court}_{type}{number}" (bare national ids
          accepted), from a search card.
        - metrics (optional, AT only): names of the metrics to return (e.g. bilanzsumme,
          umsatzerloese, equity_ratio); omitted = all. Ignored for DE.

        Returns the backend's history payload plus ``country`` and the prefixed
        ``company_id``: per-metric {year: value} with latest/latest_year. AT serves the parsed
        Bilanz/GuV/ratio series. DE serves the parsed Jahresabschluss series where the company
        has filed and its Bundesland is loaded; an empty series means not-filed or not-yet-
        loaded, never zero (see get_company_details financials.reporting_status). For a single
        snapshot use get_company_details; for the complete record use get_full_record.
name: get_company_history
title: Financial history of a company
